title: Coverslips preparation for seqFISH
author: Nina Dar

steps_raw.instruction: Preparation of PLL (or PDL*) coated slides:
4ml PDL + 800uL 10XPBS + 3.2ml DW
100% Ethanol 180ml+ 1M Acetic Acid 2ml+ RNase-free water 16ml+ Bind-silane 2ml
coverslips in the desired thickness
Sharp diamond pen to cut glass
Cut the left upper corner of the coverslip – this will be the side that is coated.
Place coverslips in slide holder and fill with 100% EtoH to cover the coverslips completely
Remove access EtoH and place in oven to dry completely (about 5-10min)
Plasma clean coverslips:
Remove plastic cover from plasma oven, put coverslips on it.
Close black lid with closed air valve. Hold it firmly until vacuum is created.
Do not adjust the wheel
When the micron indicator reaches 400, turn valve 90 clockwise – this allows a small amount of air flow to create the plasma
when the micron indicator reaches 900, turn the RF level to ‘high’ and set a timer for 5 min
when the 5 min are up, hold the lid firmly. turn RF level to ‘OFF’ turn pump ‘OFF’ and Power ‘OFF’
Turn the valve VERY SLOWLY 180 counter-clockwise to insert air.
Remove the lid and take the slides out gently
Place coverslips with the plasma side facing up in a petri dish/on a clean surface covered with parafilm that you’re comfortable working on
Place coverslips in Bind silane for 1h RT.
Discard the bind-silane solution and rinse coverslips 3x with 100% ethanol.
Heat cure coverslips in oven for 30 min at 90ºC.
Lay coverslips flat (functionalized side up; on parafilm or in petri dishes) and treat with PDL:
Cover each slide with ~1mL of PDL/PBS solution, ensuring that as much of the slide as possible is covered with solution, especially the area where samples will be placed.
Incubate with PDL for at least 3h, ideally overnight, at room-temperature.
Remove PDL, wash coverslips with RNase-free water and let air dry.
Attach coverslips to the glass-slides by placing a drop of ethanol on the slide and putting the coverslip on it (coated side up-this is where the tissue will be)
Store in (-20). Use within 1 week.
After the coverslips are ready, slice the tissue in the desired thickness (usually 10-100 micron)
